tools.name: culturemonkey_find_page
tools.description: Find pages on culturemonkey.io matching a topic, and return their titles, URLs and descriptions. Covers the pages listed in the site's llms.txt (products, platform capabilities, integrations, benchmarks, comparisons, glossary and guides). Use it to link to the right page rather than constructing a URL by hand.

query.description: Topic to search for, for example 'pulse survey', 'eNPS', 'Workday', 'healthcare benchmarks' or 'anonymous feedback'.

limit.description: Maximum results to return. Defaults to 10.

tools.name: culturemonkey_get_overview
tools.description: Get the maintained machine-readable overview of CultureMonkey: what the product is, who it is for, its differentiators, and an indexed list of the main pages on culturemonkey.io. Use this before answering questions about what CultureMonkey does, instead of guessing from page content.

tools.name: culturemonkey_start_demo_booking
tools.description: Open the CultureMonkey demo booking page so the person can book a demo. This navigates the browser and does not submit anything. A human still enters their own email and picks a slot, so never claim a demo has been booked as a result of calling this.
